pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Individual patches show a high spatial area-to-perimeter ratio on the mid-flank, with some patches exhibiting internal color graduation from dark brown centers to lighter tan peripheries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white topological graph with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the light pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing significantly as it approaches the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated mane profile visible along the dorsal neck, appearing as a dense, dark vertical fringe against the background sky.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear scar or textural disruption is visible on the lower lateral neck, characterized by a break in the standard pelage pattern and a darker, elongated mark.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, rounded ventral mass or umbilical protrusion is visible along the inferior midline of the torso.
